description: You are the security officer at a healthcare organization. Three servers have been added to EventLog Analyzer for monitoring: 'ehr-server-01' (IP: 10.10.1.10), 'pharmacy-db' (IP: 10.10.1.11), and 'billing-system' (IP: 10.10.1.12). You need to bring the SIEM into HIPAA compliance. Your tasks are: (1) navigate to the Compliance section in EventLog Analyzer, select HIPAA, and view the compliance report to assess the current status, (2) go to Settings and update the log retention period to 2555 days (7 years as required by HIPAA — look under log management or archival settings), (3) create a new alert profile named 'PHI Unauthorized Access' with Critical severity that triggers when there is 1 or more authentication failure events, and (4) export the HIPAA compliance report to a file at ~/Desktop/hipaa_compliance_report.html using the export/download option available in the reports section. Log in with username: admin, password: admin.
